summary: Frontend-only test of the redesigned 'Nouvelle intervention' modal on /interventions. All requested behaviors verified: (1) equipment → sous-équipement selection for both curative & preventive, (2) preventive maintenance dropdown filtered by selected equipment with proper empty state, (3) spare part search by name AND by reference fabricant (label shows 'Nom — Ref (stock: X)'), (4) save button disabled per validation rules, (5) sub-equipment filtered by parent. One curative test intervention created and shown with 'Curative' badge.
critical_code_review_comments: Interventions.jsx is 716 lines — consider splitting into smaller components (InterventionForm, InterventionDetail, PieceRow) for maintainability.

SearchableSelect cmdk value uses 'label + value' so any character appearing in labels matches broadly (e.g. '(' matches 222 pieces). Not a bug, but for future accuracy consider exposing custom filter.
seed_data_creation: 1 curative intervention created (titre 'TEST_Motif curatif', technicien first technician, actions 'TEST actions playwright'). Modal closed and 'Curative' badge appeared in the list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Equipment count: 32. Technicien dropdown has 1 preloaded user + allowCustom. Preventive workorders exist for some equipments (found 3 options for equip cddda0be) and correctly show 'Aucune maintenance pour cet équipement' when none exists (equip c666255b). Piece list has 222 items with format 'Nom — Reference (stock: X)'; cmdk performs substring match on label including reference — search by reference '56681' returned matches.
